citations.quote: Mould is growing behind the wardrobe in the bedroom and has spread along the ceiling.
I can't say whether the heating is actually faulty – the radiator gets warm to the touch – or whether it's simply the damp wall making the room feel cold.
We cannot agree, and I think an independent building expert must now examine the wall to establish the cause.
If the defect has not been repaired by that date, I will pay the rent into the official deposit account until the repair has been completed.
Landlord: Domicil Plus Immobilien AG, Solothurnstrasse 17, 2540 Grenchen

Start: 1 March 2015
Net rent: CHF 1620 per month
Notice period: three months
I refer to my earlier reports about the mould in my bedroom. I hereby set you a deadline: the defect must be repaired by 19 November 2026.

Domicil Plus Immobilien AG

plan.because: The supplied lease identifies the parties, property and tenancy terms.
The dated deadline letter identifies the reported bedroom mould. Delivery remains a separate question.

The reported landlord position and any proposed work or access arrangements need supporting correspondence.
Mould is reported; dated moisture and temperature observations would support the evidence review.
A heating fault is raised but remains unresolved.
Health effects are unmentioned and presumed absent for planning under the silence policy.
An independent expert examination is requested and the cause is disputed; obtain any existing inspection or arrange one as appropriate.
